fields.name: PgParameters typed PostgreSQL parameter materialization
fields.contract: PgParameters materializes the typed-parameter portion of a Query contract by appending exactly one Npgsql parameter to the supplied DbParameterCollection and returning that same collection. The operation family varies by PostgreSQL type and direction: input operations carry a supplied value and set Input; output operations reserve the declared PostgreSQL type and set Output. Supported type families are Varchar, Char, Text, Bigint, Integer, Smallint, InternalChar, Boolean, Numeric, Money, Double, Real, Timestamp, TimestampTz, Date, Time, Interval, TimeTz, Array, Bytea, Hstore, and Uuid. String and Bytea variants may specify Size; Numeric variants specify Precision and Scale; Array variants specify the element PostgreSQL type; TimeTz input variants accept either TimeSpan or DateTimeOffset.
